prompt:
Character reference sheet, one wide image in two parts, photorealistic photograph. LEFT two-thirds: full-body turnaround of the same person, three views side by side at identical scale: front view, exact 90-degree side view, exact 180-degree back view, relaxed A-pose. RIGHT third: close-up head-and-shoulders portrait of the SAME person facing camera, mouth closed. Plain light-grey background, soft even studio light at a neutral white balance, no shadows, healthy natural skin with real texture, not airbrushed, no text, no labels, no watermark.
The person: Cassie, a fictional 23-year-old, Natalie's spoiled stepsister, Lauren's daughter, who pushes Natalie into the marriage meant for her; the face, skin and build of exactly that age, which the role does not change. Appearance: A strikingly glamorous Caucasian American woman of 23 who looks young and fresh. She has a small, delicate heart-shaped face with sharp high cheekbones, a small refined nose, a pointed chin and bright, intelligent, catlike hazel eyes. Her flawless fair skin is luminous and even, with natural texture and no redness. Long, glossy, sleek platinum-tinged blonde hair falls straight to mid-back, with a centre part. Her make-up is dramatic: smoky eye make-up, thick lashes, sculpted brows and glossy nude-rose lips. She is tall and leggy, about 174 cm, with supermodel proportions, about eight heads tall. Curvy figure, full hips, defined waist, hourglass shape: a voluptuous hourglass silhouette with a confident, seductive, spoiled-rich-girl pose. She wears statement gold hoop earrings and stacked gold bangles.. Wearing one outfit only: A daring scarlet-red fitted top with thin straps and a low neckline, and a matching scarlet short miniskirt with a high side slit and a cinched high waist. Gold statement hoops, stacked gold bangles, a small gold chain-strap handbag and nude stiletto heels. No jacket.. Signature colour: red. In the close-up a calm, attractive expression with bright, intelligent eyes and only a hint of: Spoiled, arrogant, manipulative and cruel. She loves humiliating Natalie and flaunting her wealth and beauty, and she is smug about dodging the marriage to Sebastian Klein.; no tears. The full-body views keep the body's build and proportions as the appearance gives them, head-to-body ratio included, never slimmer. Cast as a commercial live-action short drama: a lead (the heroine, the hero) or a young adult woman in a prominent role is a strikingly beautiful or handsome, camera-ready actor, with the figure, make-up and hair the appearance gives; any other supporting role is an ordinary-looking person of that age.
The outfit is identical in every view and in the close-up: the same garments, accessories and details on the same side of the body, seen from that view's angle (an earring on the left ear stays on the left ear; a tie, a pocket square, gloves or hair ribbons are in every view or in none). Garments are plain, with no logo, brand mark, or printed letters or numbers.

Avoid: a different face between the views, an older-looking or younger-looking face than 23, doll-like face, a second outfit, extra people, extra limbs, text or labels.
